question: Essam asked Yasser how he ............ to school the day before.
explanation: did + infinitive -> had + P.P.; the day before -> yesterday

question: Mohammed ............ Maya why he was angry the day before.
explanation: Reporting verb followed by an object (Maya) + wh-clause

section: Grammar in points: Reported Questions (Yes/No and Wh-Questions)

question: Sama told us how she ............ the problem.
